text:
Ava (Sales): Quick heads-up - EpochAI POC: slow first-token times on long sequences and intermittent 429s during scale-ups. When they switch to our VPC private endpoint they see a 403-style error. Customer asked about a short Dedicated trial price. Can we triage?
Diego (Solutions): paste the raw auth/403 string and any X-Request-ID. what model and typical seq lengths + concurrency?
Ava (Sales): they sent: "403 egress_denied to model-host: policy restricted". X-Request-ID: xr-6b3d11. Model: rw-instruct-median (pinned). seqs mostly 900-1500. ~10 parallel clients, bursts to ~65 rps.
Sana (SRE): 2 likely contributors: (1) tiny client batch windows -> many tiny batches (low batching efficiency) which increases TTFT; (2) KV cache miss rate looks high for that shard. Check response headers for X-Redwood-RateLimit-Remaining and X-Redwood-Quota on failures.
Ilya (Eng Oncall): infra metrics show model.kv_cache.hit_rate ~0.09 over last 20m on the host serving that model 1: that will amplify token compute. Also confirm whether their VPC connector IPs are in our egress allowlist 1: 403 sounds like allowlist / subnet mismatch.
Rina (Security): For Private access we need their completed security questionnaire and allowed CIDRs. If they require customer-managed keys/HSM that adds onboarding time. For quick demo they can accept our managed keys if legal ok. Ava, can you get the SQ?
Diego (Solutions): quick ask to customer before the swarm: set client.batch_window_ms = 25-40ms to coalesce small requests, enable shared_prefix_cache on the session, and drop concurrency from 10 -> 4-6 while we observe. Also capture one failing request headers + a minimal repro prompt.
Tom (Customer Success): I'll coordinate a 30m debugging session and include SRE + Oncall. We can offer a 7-14 day Dedicated demo (single GPU) while ops investigate; pricing estimate needs finance/legal signoff. Don't promise credits yet.
deploy-bot: Deploy notice: runtime v2.14.4 rolled to prod 1: no batching config changes.
Ilya (Eng Oncall): to collect traces: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://console.redwood.dev/api/traces/xr-6b3d11` and check internal metric: `rbxctl metrics query --range 15m "model.kv_cache.hit_rate{model=\"rw-instruct-median\"}"`. If hit_rate < 0.2 we should enable shared cache and run a warmup.
Sana (SRE): also run `rbxctl quota get --tenant epochai` to see tenant concurrency and temporary bump options. If 429s correlate with quota exhaustion we can apply a short window bump for the demo.
Ava (Sales): I'll gather the SQ and failing headers now, ask them to flip batch_window to 30ms before our call at 2pm PST, and post results here. Thanks team :thumbsup:
notes: POC swarm planning: VPC 403 egress, burst 429s, low KV cache hit rate, client batching recommended, Dedicated trial/pricing flagged
